content.rule: First Conditional (If + Present Simple, Will / Won't + Infinitive)
content.explanation: We use the first conditional to talk about possible future actions/events and their likely results. The 'if' clause uses the Present Simple tense, and the main clause uses 'will' or 'won't' followed by the base verb (infinitive).
content.example: If students work hard, they will get good exam results.

items.notes: Transcribed from the source book; teacher verification required.

content.question: If we take a taxi, we .......... there on time.

content.passage: If students work hard, they will get good exam results. Good exam results usually help students to get good jobs, but what type of jobs will there be in the future? Technology is changing jobs in many countries. It is also creating completely new jobs. The jobs of the future will be very different from the jobs we do now. For example, doctors will use robots and not their hands to make people better. Small robots in hospitals will check our health and call for a doctor or a nurse if we have problems. We will speak to health navigators and they will tell us what health technology does and how it helps us. When we finish using things in the home, designers will find ways of using them to make new things. Re-wilders will look after the countryside and build parks with trees and other plants in places where there were factories in the past.

items.notes: Transcribed from the source book; teacher verification required.

content.question: Who will look after the countryside and build parks where factories used to be?
content.reason: The text explicitly states that re-wilders will look after the countryside and build parks in former factory sites.

content.script:
Presenter: Welcome to our podcast on future jobs! Today we are discussing job requirements. Job number 1: This person needs to be careful and helpful. If you have a pet that is sick, you will need to see this person.
Sara: I know this one! Is it a vet?
Presenter: Yes, it is! Well done! One point.
Presenter: Here is job number 2. This person needs to be creative and fast. If you read an online magazine, this person probably designed it.
Tyler: Is it a designer?
Presenter: Yes, it is! Well done. That is a point for each of you.
